simulator.note: Boots as an M3602-family board with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_hd8200_xwindow_1695_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8200_xwindow_1695_capture_screen.py): under 0x3603 the "M3606B 1.1.3" bootloader maps the 8 MB flash in the 16 MB window at 0xAF000000, prints "APP  init ok", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E8F2A8, exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM frames (" ON " -> "    ") with the Lemontree EuP standby and front-panel MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 44 (SCL) / 43 (SDA), and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80000200.  The application starts "M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200 (EBase 0x80000000 / 0x80000001), updates the Lemontree panel to "-ON-", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog.

desc: Amiko HD8200 Series (System ID 0A040A00) XWindow 1.6.95 by Dekolte firmware on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3606B / C3603 Full HD receiver.

Pairs dual-CPU M3606 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xA7000200) with a Lemontree EuP standby and front-panel MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 44 / 43 (" ON " -> "-ON-"), ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60.
